cat > /workspace/tmp/peel_check.py <<'PY'
import sys,importlib.util,random,time
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as s
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('old','/workspace/tmp/before_peel.py')
old=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(old)
random.seed(241)
start=time.perf_counter()
for it in range(10000):
    nodes=list(range(1,random.randrange(3,45)))
    ixps=set(random.sample(nodes,random.randrange(min(5,len(nodes)))))
    paths=[]
    if random.random()<0.5:
        for j in range(random.randrange(1,75)):
            p=random.sample(nodes,random.randrange(0,len(nodes)+1))
            if len(p) and random.random()<0.5:
                k=random.randrange(len(p));p[k:k]=[p[k]]
            paths.append(dict(path=p,count=random.randrange(1,1000001)))
    else:
        # Overlapping directed path windows peel for many rounds.
        n=len(nodes)
        for j in range(random.randrange(1,75)):
            a,b=sorted(random.sample(range(n+1),2))
            p=nodes[a:b]
            if random.random()<0.5:p=p[::-1]
            paths.append(dict(path=p,count=random.randrange(1,1000001)))
    data=dict(rib=paths)
    a=s.topology(data,ixps);b=old.topology(data,ixps)
    assert a==b,(data,ixps,a,b)
print('10k topology differential tests OK',time.perf_counter()-start)
PY
cd /workspace && python3 -B tmp/peel_check.py
